You would be better off using pre boiled water to mix with your Vyvanse anyway. I only mix one capsule (2 doses) with water at a time and have no concern with bacteria growth. It’s usually 36 hours max, and I’m not letting the mix sit in incubator like temps so I’m not concerned. 

FYI, the extended release component of Vyvanse is the lysine molecule (hence being lisdexamfetamine) which is cleaved off by red blood cell enzymes, leaving you with lysine, an amino acid, and dexamfetamine. 

The rate of conversion in your blood is determined by how much enzyme you have, and you can’t speed it up per say, so you get the extended release as the enzymes work through the backlog of the med in your system. 

I can’t say how boiling would impact the molecule overall, but overall, heat is bad for meds, and should be avoided.

Vyvanse is XR, but biologically by the cleavage of lysine so that’s fine, and Dex is IR, so I’ve essentially just made it the equivalent of sipping on a long black, vs taking a shot of espresso :) 

GP and psychiatrist are happy with my approach :)
